legend.0: At least two colors clash outright, such as competing bright colors or tones that fight each other
legend.1: Nothing clashes outright, but the colors look unrelated, as if each piece was picked on its own
legend.2: The colors sit together safely, such as all neutrals or one color repeated, without a clear idea behind them
legend.3: The colors were clearly chosen together: a tonal palette, complementary colors, or neutrals with one accent that ties the pieces together

legend.0: Several busy patterns compete, such as florals with checks and stripes
legend.1: Two patterns are combined without a shared color or a difference in scale, so they fight for attention
legend.2: All pieces are solid, one patterned piece is balanced by plain pieces, or the patterns share a color and differ in scale

legend.0: Pieces from opposite ends of formality are mixed, such as a tailored blazer with gym shorts or heels with sweatpants
legend.1: One piece is clearly more formal or more casual than the rest and looks out of place
legend.2: The pieces are close in formality, with a small gap that reads as relaxed rather than wrong
legend.3: Every piece sits at the same level of formality

legend.0: The proportions fight each other, such as oversized pieces on top and bottom that swallow the body
legend.1: The proportions are off in one place, such as a top whose length or volume overwhelms the bottom
legend.2: The proportions are acceptable but nothing gives the outfit a shape
legend.3: Volume and fit are balanced, such as a loose piece paired with a fitted one, giving the outfit a clear shape

legend.0: The cuts work against the user's body type and height, such as hiding the waist of an hourglass figure or cutting the legs of a short user
legend.1: One piece works against the user's body type or height while the rest are neutral
legend.2: The cuts neither help nor hurt the user's body type and height, or the body is unknown
legend.3: The cuts favor the user's body type and height, such as defining the waist or lengthening the legs where that helps

legend.0: The outfit is dangerous for the weather, such as sandals and shorts in snow or a heavy coat in a heat wave
legend.1: The outfit is uncomfortable for the weather: clearly too warm, too cold, or without protection on a rainy day
legend.2: The weather is unknown, or the outfit suits it only in part
legend.3: The outfit suits the weather, with a small mismatch such as a layer that is slightly too light
legend.4: The outfit is exactly right for the temperature and the rain or sun, with suitable shoes and layers

legend.0: The outfit is wrong for the occasion, such as gym wear at the office or an evening gown at home
legend.1: The outfit is out of step with the occasion, too formal or too casual in a way other people would notice
legend.2: The outfit is acceptable for the occasion, though one piece is a little off
legend.3: The outfit is exactly what the occasion calls for

legend.0: The outfit contradicts every style the user likes, such as a tracksuit for someone who only likes elegant looks
legend.1: The outfit has little to do with the styles the user likes
legend.2: The outfit partly reflects one of the user's styles, or the user listed no styles
legend.3: The outfit clearly expresses one or more of the styles the user likes
